caveats: These are station observations for one year, not district averages, a nationwide spatial surface, a weather forecast or a long-term climate normal. Station names alone do not establish instrument coordinates or catchment boundaries. Do not sum temperatures or humidity, or treat rainfall at several stations as a national total. Blank night-humidity cells remain unavailable. The Badulla temperature is 23.9 °C in the rendered table; a stray 29.0 in the PDF text layer is excluded after visual review.
Blank source cells remain null with not-available status. Visible table cells were reviewed because text extraction includes a stray hidden temperature and omits blank column positions.
grain: One reported meteorological measure by observation station in 2025
notes: The Department of Meteorology figures reproduced in the Pocket Book report average temperature, average day and night relative humidity, and rainfall for 24 observation stations in 2025. Temperature is in degrees Celsius, humidity in percent and rainfall in millimetres. Nine night-humidity cells are unreported.
